(async()=>{for(const pt of [[1000,1000],[7000,1000],[7000,5000],[1000,5000],[1000,1000]])await demoPoint(...pt);const walls=demoRead().walls.filter(w=>w.levelId===demoLevel);if(walls.length!==4)throw Error("Expected four saved walls");return {walls:walls.length}})()

(async()=>{await demoPoint(2500,5000);const p=demoRead(),ids=p.walls.filter(w=>w.levelId===demoLevel).map(w=>w.id);if(!p.openings.some(o=>o.kind==="door"&&ids.includes(o.wallId)))throw Error("Door not saved");return "Door cut into wall"})()
